capabilities.name: Synthetic signal lab
capabilities.summary: Generate waveforms, tune gain and EMA smoothing, inspect plotted signals and pointer normalization.
capabilities.notes: Requires Tkinter and a graphical desktop. Does not need sensor access.
capabilities.use_when: Explore waveforms, filtering, smoothing, or input normalization without hardware.

capabilities.name: Kinect depth capture
capabilities.summary: Display a depth stream from the Kinect 1473 using the previously working native libfreenect installation.
capabilities.notes: Original Pi demonstrated depth capture; migrated launcher is not verified. Camera may be busy if another program holds USB.
capabilities.use_when: Check whether the Kinect depth camera works and inspect raw distance images.

capabilities.name: Hand tracking and gesture input
capabilities.summary: Existing MediaPipe-based hand landmarks, pointer mapping and pinch interaction; original code remains device/GUI coupled.
capabilities.notes: Not imported or validated on the Pi; do not treat as a stable Lib primitive.
capabilities.use_when: Investigate finger landmarks, pinch, gesture-to-input, and motion controls.

capabilities.name: Multi-camera compositing
capabilities.summary: A future capability to compose synchronized visual streams from multiple cameras.
capabilities.notes: A research direction; no implementation or synchronization guarantees yet.
capabilities.use_when: Investigate camera synchronization, combined viewpoints, and spatial reconstruction.

capabilities.name: Nearest depth point (native C)
capabilities.summary: Find the closest valid Kinect depth pixel with a small C function, independent of graphics.
capabilities.use_when: Detect the nearest object to a camera, prototype hand approach, or investigate low-cost motion input.
capabilities.notes: New integration, not yet verified on Pi. Invoke with the Python interpreter/environment where freenect already works. Camera use is exclusive; Ctrl+C exits.

capabilities.name: Kinect 3D air canvas
capabilities.summary: Draw in the air by tracking a near depth point and overlaying its trail on RGB video.
capabilities.use_when: Explore embodied drawing, near-field interaction, depth-to-action mapping or gesture game ideas.
capabilities.notes: Imported experiment, not validated after migration. Run in working Kinect environment; opens a GUI and uses camera exclusively. Press q to quit, c to clear.

capabilities.name: Headless compute / UI observer
capabilities.summary: Demonstrates 60 synthetic processing steps with only 10 optional presentation summaries.
capabilities.use_when: Understand how experimental computation can be separated from visual refresh work.
capabilities.notes: No display or Kinect needed. Single-threaded demonstration only; not independent scheduling.

capabilities.name: Gravity field playground
capabilities.summary: Move gravitational attractors and watch bounded particles respond; an interactive toy for orbital intuition and control experiments.
capabilities.use_when: Experiment with attraction, orbital paths, force strength, chaotic trajectories, or potential motion-controlled interactions.
capabilities.notes: Toy force field, not calibrated physical gravity. Bounded to 48 particles and 25 redraws/sec; not yet tested on Pi. Space pauses, R resets, C clears trails.

capabilities.name: Motion-controlled Smash Bros (research)
capabilities.summary: Original full-body pose tracking, joint-angle features, clustering and experimental mapping to Smash Bros actions.
capabilities.use_when: Investigate gesture-controlled fighting games, pose transitions, and temporal action recognition.
capabilities.notes: Legacy research, not currently a validated or safe Console launch target; live input injection must remain disabled until ported.
